description: This PHP file implements the unified search functionality for the vtiger CRM system, handling search queries, module filtering, rendering search results with Smarty templates, and managing user interface components related to search.

methods.name: getSearchModules
methods.description: Retrieves list of modules available for global search, filtering out disabled or non-searchable modules.

methods.name: getSearchModulesComboList
methods.description: Generates a dynamic dropdown for selecting which module to search within, with accompanying JavaScript for UI interaction.
